examples.note: Always call compile() before forward(). Layers are added in order.
Use make_shared for memory management. Activation is optional for most layers.
Weights must be loaded after compile(). File format is nntrainer's native binary format.

notes: All tensors use row-major (C-style) memory layout
Always include <nntrainer/neuralnet.h> and use namespace nntrainer or full qualification
Use std::make_shared for layer allocation; raw pointers are not recommended
forward() and backward() should maintain tensor shape consistency
For training: call backward() after forward(), then optimizer.step()
Layer initialization happens automatically on first forward() or explicit initialize()
